items.title: Maria Schneider interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: they wanted to meet, he and Devra Hall, his wife, and so we were talking

ctx.x: And so John visited the college and I actually got to interview John and he is, I’m pleased to hear that you’ve got an association with him.

I’m so excited, I’m just like so happy. I mean I called them for a recommendation. I never in a million years thought he’d take me on. And I sat down with him and I said — you know because then they wanted to meet, he and Devra Hall, his wife, and so we were talking and I said, I showed him my whole schedule for the year. I said, “well I know this is peanuts.” You know, he’s worked with all the greats. What I make, financially, and can bring to them is nothing. So I said, “I realize this isn’t much.” And he said,…
Right. Joe spoke very, very highly of him. They had a relationship for so many years and they said it was just on a handshake and that they just —
